title: Replace site logo with uploaded image

requirements.text: Add the user-provided logo image as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated in two sizes (128x128 and 512x512), optimized for web usage and preserving transparency if present.

quotes: Pls replace the logo with this image

acceptanceCriteria: Two new logo files exist in frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames and dimensions.
The generated logo images look visually consistent with the uploaded image (same mark and text), with clean edges and no unexpected cropping.
The 128x128 version remains legible at small sizes (header use).

requirements.text: Update frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts to point BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard and BRAND_ASSETS.logo.large to the newly added generated logo asset paths so the header (and any other logo usage) displays the new logo.

quotes: Pls replace the logo with this image

acceptanceCriteria: BRAND_ASSETS.logo.standard references the new 128x128 logo asset path.
BRAND_ASSETS.logo.large references the new 512x512 logo asset path.
The header logo displayed in frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx renders the new image without layout breakage (no overflow, no distortion, sizes unchanged).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not edit immutable hook files (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep backend unchanged (no Motoko changes required).
nonGoals: Do not change the site name text (e.g., "Terra Vedant Tech") or other marketing copy.
Do not redesign header layout, spacing, or navigation beyond what is necessary to swap the logo asset.

required: Square logo image with white background, based on the uploaded logo (terra-vedant-logo-new.dim_128x128.png)
Square logo image with white background, based on the uploaded logo (terra-vedant-logo-new.dim_512x512.png)
